content:
SECTION 1
* The writer agrees with Sajid Javid that older people unfairly criticize young adults for spending money on things like holidays or meals.
* They say rising house prices and fewer mortgages make it very hard for someone their age to buy a home.
* As a result, many young people end up renting for life and feel blamed for not saving enough.
* Young workers under 25 are paid lower legal minimum wages (for example £7.05 or £5.60 per hour), even for the same jobs as older colleagues.
* Low pay and unstable contracts (like zero-hours) mean full-time young workers can still earn very little, around £14,500 a year, making saving for a house almost impossible.
